record.question:
Using the mutation data from `df_mutation` and cancer subtype data from `df_diag`, determine the prevalence of the TP53 gene mutation across different cancer subtypes. 

Output the results as a `pd.Series` named `output_df`, ordered by the count of mutations from largest to smallest.
record.answer:
{"reference_answer": "import pandas as pd
df_mutation = pd.read_csv("/workdir/gene_mutation_dna_sub.csv")
df_diag = pd.read_csv("/workdir/diagnosis_outcome_sub.csv")
pindex = df_mutation[df_mutation["TP53"] == 1]["sample"]
output_df = df_diag[df_diag["sample"].isin(pindex)]["cancer type abbreviation"].value_counts()", "test_cases": "assert len(output_df) == 26

assert output_df.iloc[1] == 42"}
